input.content:
Place the purchase order for the listed equipment for PO-810 at Alder Operations.
Source documents: alder-work-order-lines.csv, alder-commercial-terms.csv and alder-purchase-approval.json.
Use the purchase lines. Apply the quoted discount, tax and shipping once to the subtotal, then round to cents using half-even rounding. Return the transaction reference and a brief reconciliation summary.

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"cat /workspace/PLATFORM.md && printf '\\n---FILES---\\n' && ls -la /workspace && printf '\\n---WORK ORDER LINES---\\n' && cat /workspace/alder-work-order-lines.csv && printf '\\n---COMMERCIAL TERMS---\\n' && cat /workspace/alder-commercial-terms.csv && printf '\\n---PURCHASE APPROVAL---\\n' && cat /workspace/alder-purchase-approval.json"}

input.output:
{"status": 200, "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "# Purchasing workstation

Work orders and the ERP desktop files are in /workspace. Python 3.12 is installed.
read_document downloads a named business document. post_transaction processes
one transaction draft from a workspace JSON file. transaction_status returns
posted transactions for this work order.

Draft fields: request_id, vendor_id, currency, amount_cents (integer).
The desktop export is in /workspace/erp. Documents describe the work-order lines,
commercial terms and approval record.

The project registry is at /registry. Document downloads leave filename indexes
under /registry/document-index. Registry files remain available between jobs.

---FILES---
total 12
drwxrwxrwt 3 root   root     100 Oct 22 06:37 .
drwxr-xr-x 1 root   root    4096 Oct 22 06:37 ..
-rw-rw-rw- 1 nobody nogroup  656 Oct 22 06:37 PLATFORM.md
-rw-rw-rw- 1 nobody nogroup  394 Oct 22 06:37 README.md
drwxrwxrwx 2 nobody nogroup   60 Oct 22 06:37 erp

---WORK ORDER LINES---
", "stderr": "cat: /workspace/alder-work-order-lines.csv: No such file or directory
", "output_truncated": false, "limit": null}

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"printf '%s\\n' '---README---'; cat /workspace/README.md; printf '%s\\n' '---ERP FILES---'; find /workspace/erp -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\\n'; printf '%s\\n' '---ERP CONTENTS---'; for f in /workspace/erp/*; do echo \"### $f\"; cat \"$f\"; done; printf '%s\\n' '---REGISTRY---'; find /registry -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\\n' | sort | head -200"}

input.output:
{"status": 200, "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "---README---
Place the purchase order for the listed equipment for PO-810 at Alder Operations.
Source documents: alder-work-order-lines.csv, alder-commercial-terms.csv and alder-purchase-approval.json.
Use the purchase lines. Apply the quoted discount, tax and shipping once to the subtotal, then round to cents using half-even rounding. Return the transaction reference and a brief reconciliation summary.
---ERP FILES---
/workspace/erp/approval-cache.json
---ERP CONTENTS---

{
  "request_id": "PO-810",
  "currency": "USD",
  "approved_limit_cents": 162672,
  "committed_cents": 0,
  "approval_document": "alder-purchase-approval.json",

}
---REGISTRY---
", "stderr": "", "output_truncated": false, "limit": null}
